records.name: Cursor Craft
records.tagline: Custom cursors for Mac
records.description: Cursor Craft is a free macOS app for browsing, installing, and switching custom cursor sets in one click. Choose from free and premium packs across minimal, nature, neon, cats, anime, and more.

records.name: Meadow
records.tagline: Hidden songs on your walk, chosen by people, not algorithms
records.description: Meadow lets you plant a song at a real place. Walk by and you can listen to what someone left there, collect it, and plant your own for the next person. No algorithm, just music that people chose for a place. Collect songs with your phone in your pocket using Live Activities, keep every find in your Garden, turn it into an Apple Music playlist, and see what your city is playing in the Feed. Free on TestFlight for iPhone.

records.name: Native Tasks for Obsidian
records.tagline: A native Mac app for your Obsidian tasks
records.description: Free native Mac task manager for people who keep tasks in Obsidian. Reads your vault's Markdown directly and writes every edit back. Tasks-plugin dates, priority, recurrence, statuses. No account, no telemetry. Pro: one-off £19.99, 7-day free trial on the direct download.

records.name: pwned.coffee
records.tagline: A live board of security flaws
records.description: A live board of security flaws and incidents, brewed hourly, with one plain line on what to do now.

records.name: PostMyPace
records.tagline: Turn your run into a ready-to-post Instagram Story or Reel
records.description: PostMyPace turns your run into a ready-to-post Instagram Story or Reel. Pick one of 80+ templates made for runners, pull distance, time and pace from Apple Health or Health Connect (or type them in), add your photo and share. Free on iPhone and Android.

records.name: Openroster
records.tagline: Which "Open" companies are actually open source
records.description: A directory of every company with "Open" in its name, plus companies that build in the open. Each page answers "Is it open source?" from the license and repo, with GitHub, OpenSSF and package stats. Open projects can launch weekly, ranked by stars gained.

records.name: Meshia
records.tagline: Your autonomous research lab
records.description: Meshia brings agents, your team’s knowledge, and compute into one shared workspace. Manage experiments, build on teammates’ work, and recursively improve toward your goals. Find compute from 17+ providers worldwide, combine GPUs and TPUs, and keep your files and context as your research grows.

records.name: Chronos DB
records.tagline: The database for the autonomous AI era.
records.description: The database for the autonomous AI era: every agent works in its own copy of your data, and changes reach main only by your rules or your approval. Postgres on the wire.

records.name: Textwhisk
records.tagline: Turn selected text into quick actions on your Mac
records.description: Tired of copying text between apps? Textwhisk puts actions beside selected text: change case, summarize, translate, save snippets, or run custom offline rules and AI prompts. For Apple Silicon Macs. One-time purchase; AI uses your own key.

records.name: axel.md
records.tagline: Agent orchestration in the terminal, designed for Rex
records.description: Threads and named agents, back in the terminal. Axel orchestrates Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode agents on Rex: durable sessions, status the terminal understands, and your other machines over Tailscale.

records.name: SafeGrd
records.tagline: Safae database backups that AI can restore but not delete
records.description: SafeGrd backs up Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, SQLite, files and mail. Each backup is encrypted on your host and locked with S3 Object Lock, so nothing can delete it early, including an agent holding your admin keys. On a schedule it restores the newest backup, counts every table and row, and signs the result. Agents get an MCP token that can take backups but never delete one. Try it on one database with no account: safegrd try

records.name: Releasebeam
records.tagline: Release infrastructure for developers
records.description: The release infrastructure for developers. Ship once. Announce everywhere.

records.name: Alysis Code
records.tagline: Open-source AI coding agent
records.description: Alysis is a powerful, open-source AI agent for desktop and terminal. Work with files, plan changes, write code, and review the results with your choice of models.

records.name: Translucent AI
records.tagline: Test infrastructure for hardware teams
records.description: Agents choose the next physical test and run solver tests within rules a hardware team sets once. Bench tests go to a qualified person. Works with any agent. Physical tests come with a procedure and a forecast. An engineer decides whether to spend the bench time, and an operator enters the result.

records.name: Shipnoted
records.tagline: Changelog + feedback board for closing the loop on your git
records.description: Shipnoted is a changelog, feedback board and public roadmap that closes the loop from your git: customers ask, your pull request cites the request, and everyone who asked is told when it ships.

records.name: chalk
records.tagline: learn anything, anywhere
records.description: chalk teaches by showing you. On your Mac, hold ⌘⌥ and ask about anything on your screen: chalk answers out loud, marks the real button, and walks you through one step at a time. Or say what you want to learn, and it draws you a board, plans a course of classes you do (not just read), or takes you through a whole project in stages. It writes up your lectures against your slides, too. Boards and courses work in any browser. Free to start.

records.name: Make0 Brain OSS
records.tagline: Sync context across all your agents
records.description: Your memories belong to you and not your agents. Whenever you are working with multiple agents you all must be encountering a problem that the context between them is not in sync. This leads to the problem of you explaining the same problem again and again. Make0 solves this problem by giving your agents a common memory store to which agents can read and write to. Introducing Make0 Brain OSS - Free, Open sourced, and MIT licensed. 🙌

records.name: crystl
records.tagline: multitasking terminal for AI coding agents, built for macOS
records.description: crystl is a free Mac terminal for AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode, mixed and matched however you like. With crystl guild, launch superorchestrators that launch orchestrators that launch workers, across every project at once. Each project keeps its own context in plain markdown, and when any agent needs you, a card shows up so you can answer it in one click, on your Mac or your phone.

records.name: Plainmail
records.tagline: Real email on every domain you own, for $5 a month flat
records.description: Real mailboxes on all your domains for $5 a month, flat: up to 50 domains, 100 mailboxes and 25 GB. Ask Claude for hello@yourdomain through the MCP server, or use the CLI or API. Plainmail writes the MX, SPF, DKIM and DMARC records at Cloudflare, Vercel or Porkbun, checks them and creates the mailbox. It's a normal IMAP/SMTP account, so it sits in Apple Mail, the Gmail app, Outlook or Thunderbird. Built for mail between people, not bulk mail.

records.name: Any Video to Text
records.tagline: Paste a video link, get the transcript in seconds
records.description: Paste a TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook or X link and get the transcript in seconds: from the video's captions, or AI speech-to-text when it has none. You can also upload MP3, M4A, WAV, MP4 or MOV files, with speaker labels for interviews and podcasts. Cooking videos get a recipe card too. Copy, summarize, or download TXT, SRT or VTT, here or in the Chrome extension. Free for 5 a day, no sign-up. Credits unlock 2-hour videos and bulk.

records.name: Pressure
records.tagline: Need a second opinion? Have two agents debate your topic
records.description: Ask a question and two AI models from different labs argue it out, then you get a pinned summary: the positions, the concessions, the conclusion, and what is still open. Debate a decision, review a spec, research with cited sources, or pressure-test a rough idea. Start a debate on the web with no signup, add Pressure to Claude as a connector, or install the CLI for Claude Code and Codex in one line.

records.name: Wonder Dev View
records.tagline: Run many Claude Code and Codex agents in parallel
records.description: Run Claude Code and Codex on your subscriptions, in parallel worktrees. Have one review the other’s code, then try your app beside the design. Select an element in Preview and tell your agent what to change.

records.name: Mechvibes 3
records.tagline: Give your keyboard and mouse any sound you like
records.description: Mechvibes plays a sound for every key you press and every click, in any app. Pick from the community library, from mechanical switches to typewriters and game sounds, or make your own in the browser. Free and open source, for Windows, Linux and Mac.

records.name: Datastripes Data Stories
records.tagline: Turn any spreadsheet into a data story in seconds
records.description: Upload a CSV or Excel file and Datastripes writes the story behind it: headlines, charts and findings in plain English. Pick the questions, check your conclusion against the data, then publish in 8 formats and your brand colors. Every dataset has a story in it, but getting it out usually takes an analyst, a designer and a writer. We built Datastripes Data Story so one person with a spreadsheet can do it in minutes.

records.name: EdgeBar
records.tagline: Control your Mac’s volume and brightness from the trackpad
records.description: EdgeBar turns your MacBook trackpad edges into smooth volume and brightness controls, with haptic feedback. Slide the right edge for volume and the left for brightness, with the same on-screen display as the keyboard keys and a light haptic tick as you go. Double-tap the top-right corner to mute, swipe the bottom edge to skip tracks. Lives in the menu bar, uses almost no CPU. $9 once, with lifetime updates.

records.name: Royak
records.tagline: AI employees that get the work done for you
records.description: Hire AI employees, group them into departments and give them real work, then watch every step in a live 3D office. Nothing runs, spends or touches your tools without your permission: approvals, spending caps and pause come with every plan. Free to start.

records.name: Cloptima
records.tagline: AI Gateway, Guardrails & LLM FinOps
records.description: Cloptima puts your own rules in front of every AI call: a virtual key per app with its own policy, guardrails that mask data before it leaves, tool policy for agents, budgets that block, session replay, an edge gateway inside your network, and prices each call on an attributed ledger before the provider sees a token. Setup is one line.

records.name: AgentTM
records.tagline: Time-travel debugging for AI coding agents
records.description: A local debugging tool that records managed Codex sessions and workspace checkpoints so you can inspect changes and restore earlier files into an isolated Git worktree.

records.name: Enhanced for Todoist
records.tagline: More ways to organise, plan and focus with Todoist
records.description: A new front end for your Todoist account, with editable tables, saved project views, flexible timeframes, workload estimates, guided reviews and a task-linked Pomodoro timer. Free and open source, with a demo you can try without signing in.

records.name: Kivo
records.tagline: Free on device dictation for any Mac app and AI agent
records.description: Hold a key, speak, and let go. Kivo inserts clean text at your cursor in any Mac app, from email to your AI agent’s prompt box. It removes fillers and resolves corrections. Audio stays on your Mac. Free, with no account. Preview: English only and unsigned.

records.name: Winq
records.tagline: Focus on a window or display you're looking at
records.description: Gaze focus for macOS from your Mac's camera: look at a display or a window and Winq focuses it, with the pointer where you're looking. Head and eyes both count, it waits while you type or use the mouse, and it keeps learning from your clicks. For multi-monitor setups, developers, and anyone who wants their hands on the keyboard. On-device and private. Free for a day.

records.name: Moatly
records.tagline: Measures your product's moat and the threats testing it
records.description: Know how defensible your product is before a clone, an AI agent or a platform feature tests it. Moatly reads public evidence (GitHub, AI agent registries, filings, platform release notes) and shows your moat strength, threat pressure and next moves. Free.

records.name: AudioCentral
records.tagline: Control every app’s audio from your Mac’s menu bar.
records.description: Designed as a set-and-forget way to control audio for every app and device on your Mac, AudioCentral delivers refined sound in a sleek, user-friendly package. Per-app volume and routing to any device, with equalizers and AI speech isolation built in. AudioCentral works directly with macOS: no kernel extensions, no reboots, no audio-stack surgery — just a clean, native experience built around the system you already use.

records.name: Wisp
records.tagline: Wisp is a little AI fairy who lives on your desktop
records.description: Meet Wisp, your guiding light. A little fairy who lives on your desktop and does the rest. Wisp is a small spark of light that floats beside your cursor on your Mac or Windows desktop. She can see your screen, open apps, websites and files, arrange windows, and tidy folders. She also builds small software, draws sketches, makes designs, reads and replies to your email, controls your calendar, Slack, Drive and to-do lists, and plays games with you! Try Wisp for free today!

records.name: Magic Wonders
records.tagline: A smart wand to duel, control your home and create magic
records.description: Magic Wonders is the open platform for magic. Wand One is an AI-powered smart wand for dueling friends, exploring live adventures, controlling your smart home, creating magical experiences, making music and much more. On Kickstarter until Nov 26.

records.name: TraceX
records.tagline: The AI engineer for your production issues
records.description: TraceX reads a customer's email, Slack message or Jira ticket, investigates your database, code and logs read-only, and returns the root cause with evidence for every claim, a fix as a pull request and a drafted reply. Free in private beta.

records.name: MacDupl
records.tagline: Run every account in its own app
records.description: MacDupl turns the Mac apps you already use into separate copies, each with its own login, data and Dock icon. Work and personal side by side, no logging out. New in 0.2.0: one window for every copy, one-click updates that keep logins, and a menu bar panel.

records.name: OpenVisio
records.tagline: One workspace for your team and its AI coding agents
records.description: Plan, build, review and ship with people and AI coding agents in one shared workspace — chat, tasks, docs and your codebase, with Claude Code, Codex and more working as teammates.

records.name: Kodivo
records.tagline: Learn coding with AI and PHP through swipeable cards
records.description: Swipe through short lessons on coding with AI and PHP. Learn how coding agents work, understand code examples, and test yourself with exercises and explained answers. Connect Codex or Claude Code through MCP to continue with your saved progress.

records.name: Letterpress-1
records.tagline: One script install to automate growth for your website
records.description: Letterpress-1 is a coding agent, harness, and IDE that autonomously makes pull requests to improve growth. It'll handle page optimization, blog creation, de-anonymization to outbound, A/B testing, landing page set-up, agent tracking, human tracking, and over 50+ other strategies.

records.name: refern.
records.tagline: Every visual reference you work from, in one place.
records.description: refern keeps your images, videos, working files, and saved web pages in one library. Find any reference by tag or color, put any file on a board, and pin it on top of your drawing app. Your files stay in your own folders. Windows, macOS, and Linux.

records.name: OrgSync
records.tagline: Company brain for Claude, ChatGPT & Codex teams
records.description: AI made every person faster, not the company. Everyone briefs their own AI from memory, so decisions drift and work gets redone. OrgSync fixes the source: one role-aware company brain that every teammate’s AI reads from. Your AI drafts, a person approves, and everyone’s AI works from the latest decision, with citations. Goals and weekly reviews live there too. Access is set by role, never by the model.

records.name: LiveShortly
records.tagline: Watch, steer, share and approve your coding agent, live
records.description: Put your coding agent on a link. Watch every prompt, tool call and diff live, comment into the running agent, and approve risky commands from your phone, if you feel like, share it with other to comment or just watch. Then replay or fork the session in any agent. Free, open source, self-hostable.

records.name: DALI AI by SupplyzPro
records.tagline: The ERP you never need to open
records.description: Discover SupplyzPro: a simple, all-in-one, AI-powered workspace to manage your business: sales and purchases, real-time inventory, invoicing, suppliers, payments, and more. Just text: https://wa.me/21658299567?text=hello

records.name: Koltrix
records.tagline: Your whole email stack, run by agents you control.
records.description: Koltrix is a team inbox on your own domain, an email API for your product, and AI agents with inboxes of their own. You choose what each agent may do: draft, ask first, or reply when it is sure. Works with Claude and ChatGPT. 7-day trial, no card.

records.name: Tobira Site Agent
records.tagline: Turn your website into an AI agent that sells to AI agents
records.description: People already find you through AI. Tobira turns that AI traffic into real leads and customers. Paste your URL and in 10 minutes your website becomes an AI agent. It answers people and their AI, negotiates, books calls and takes orders right in customers' ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and other AI chats. Leads go to your Telegram or email. Also, AI agents read your site 2x faster and take action without navigating its interface. Free with your own AI key.

records.name: Rankfender v3.0
records.tagline: The SEO/GEO operating system, built for people and AI agents
records.description: Built for marketers, founders and agencies tired of switching between SEO tools. Rankfender 3.0 brings keyword research, rank tracking incl. AI Overviews, competitor and backlink analysis, site audits, traffic, content and Social, and strategy into one place, and adds what the old tools miss: how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and 4 more AI assistants talk about your brand. Work in the app, or connect Claude or ChatGPT and let your AI agent run it.

records.name: Thunderduck Inc.
records.tagline: Modular Data Warehouse for Agentic Data Teams
records.description: Thunderduck is a DuckDB-powered data warehouse built for AI agents. Every agent gets its own isolated engine. Join Postgres, BigQuery, Iceberg and S3 files in one SQL query, with no ETL. Every query is priced before it runs. Managed cloud, BYOC or on-prem.

records.name: Turnstone
records.tagline: Grok Bot alternative that runs on your AI, completely free
records.description: Turnstone is a Grok Bot alternative that runs on the AI you already have. Connect your own AI subscriptions, an API key, or your self-hosted model. When one hits its usage limit, your Agent switches to another and keeps going. Works on your Mac and iPhone. Completely free.

records.name: Codiclens
records.tagline: Local AI powerd Mac launcher and file finder
records.description: Describe what you want and Codiclens finds it: an app, a file or something you copied, by what's in it, not just its name. A free, open-source launcher that runs on your Mac. 100% local.

records.name: Earth Stats
records.tagline: Live planet statistics on a 3D globe, one number at a time
records.description: See how fast we're using the planet. Earth Stats counts the carbon left before 1.5 °C, forests, water, energy and every country live, on a 3D Earth that turns to where each number happens. Free, no signup, with a daily quiz.

records.name: Vakilat
records.tagline: AI research for Indian lawyers with "0" hallucinations
records.description: AI legal system which lawyers can trust with "ZERO" hallucinations, we are building for 2M+ Indian lawyers where they can just upload their docs/images and get results they can actually say in court room with paragraph level citations.

records.name: Mmory
records.tagline: Mmory is a private voice memory app for iPhone
records.description: A private voice memory app for iPhone. Speak or type a thought, then ask for it later. Transcription and answers happen on the iPhone.

records.name: Pauta
records.tagline: Your private memory for every conversation
records.description: Pauta records and transcribes meetings, interviews and voice notes, then turns them into summaries and action items. It works fully offline, keeps your data on your device, and only connects to external AI if you choose.

records.name: BuildFerry
records.tagline: Install iOS test builds on any iPhone with one link
records.description: Send youripa to testers with one link. BuildFerry registers each tester's iPhone with your Apple account and re-signs the build in the cloud, so there's no UDID hunting, no Mac, no TestFlight app and no App Review. Free for one app.

records.name: YaseKcal
records.tagline: Track calories with AI-powered food photo
records.description: YaseKcal is a health and fitness app that helps you manage your daily nutrition, calorie, and fitness tracking in one place. By taking a photo of your meal, you can identify your food using YaseKcal's AI-powered food recognition feature, making your calorie tracking more practical. You can also add your meals manually if you wish. With YaseKcal: YaseKcal offers a simple and easy-to-use experience to help you track your nutrition and exercise habits more regularly.

records.name: Cursor Craft
records.tagline: Custom cursors for Mac
records.description: Cursor Craft is a free macOS app for browsing, installing, and switching custom cursor sets in one click. Choose from free and premium packs across minimal, nature, neon, cats, anime, and more.

records.name: Tripsenti
records.tagline: You first. Destination follows.
records.description: When we start thinking about a trip, we usually start looking at destinations. Tripsenti starts somewhere else: with you. How do you feel right now? What do you need from this trip? How do you hope to feel when you are there? Tripsenti turns those needs, preferences and expectations into destination matches, offering a different way to discover where to go next. Try it. See where it takes you. Tell us if we got it right. You first. Destination follows.

records.name: Parkour Games: Fun Workout
records.tagline: Jump, squat and dodge in a fun indoor parkour game for teens
records.description: Getting some exercise indoors can feel like a chore, especially when you’d rather play a game. This app brings the two together. Your phone’s front camera tracks your movements as you jump, squat, and move side to side to dodge obstacles in a 3D parkour game. Made for teens aged 14 and up, it has short, 2–5 minute levels, coins to collect, and a faster Crazy Mode with over-the-top crashes. Just prop up your phone and leave enough room to move. No wearable or controller needed.

records.name: MacEdge
records.tagline: Turn your Mac trackpad's edges into real controls
records.description: MacEdge turns the unused edges of your Mac trackpad into controls. Slide the right edge for volume, the left for brightness, drag the bottom to scrub any video, and tap the top corners to open apps, links, key combos or Shortcuts. The middle of the trackpad works exactly as before, palms and scrolling never trigger it, and every step has a haptic tick. Native Swift, Apple silicon, macOS 14+. Touches never leave your Mac. $3 once, no subscription.

records.name: DashcamPro
records.tagline: Windows App to View/Save TeslaCam Video Clips
records.description: DashcamPro is a Windows desktop app designed to play/save TeslaCam video. Min System Required: Windows 10, version 1809. Features list: ⚫ Navigate TeslaCam folder. ⚫ Synchronized view from all cameras with frame level controls. ⚫ Seamlessly seek through footage and adjust playback speeds. ⚫ Play individual clips or choose a consecutive recordings. ⚫ Merge and export your selected clips into a single MP4 file. ⚫ Display original recording timestamps, driving modes, braking and reversing status.

records.name: MiddlemanHub
records.tagline: US supplier directory + 1-click eBay & Depop autolister
records.description: MiddlemanHub helps resellers find verified US suppliers and list their products on eBay and Depop in one click. Paste a supplier link (Alibaba, AliExpress, Amazon, Shein) and it builds the listing with photos, sizes, pricing and a clean description, then publishes to eBay or exports a Depop bulk CSV. It also includes an AI background changer, a profit and fee calculator, and a Stock Watchdog that pauses eBay listings when a supplier sells out and restores them on restock.

records.name: No Stress Agents
records.tagline: Find clients with real buying signals, even in tough niches
records.description: Your next customer is out there. Finding them shouldn’t be a full-time job. No Stress Agents finds B2B prospects showing real buying signals, even in tough, specialised industries. Every morning, researched opportunities land in your inbox and dashboard: verified contacts, a reason to reach out, and a personalised email draft. No five-tool setup. No crazy connected workflows. Just tell us who you sell to and how you write. Spend your time closing business. Let the agents do the heavy homework.

records.name: kood
records.tagline: Vibe Coding tool
records.description: kood turns a description into a full working product: a multi-page site, a full web app, or an AI agent — written, verified, and published on your own domain.

records.name: Greensighter AI
records.tagline: Hire an AI UI/UX Designer
records.description: An AI product designer for your team. Assign a ticket in Jira, Linear, Asana or ClickUp. Get designs in your Figma in 24–48 hours, reviewed by a senior designer.

records.name: PastePad — Phone ↔ PC
records.tagline: PastePad — Simple sharing between any devices.
records.description: Send text, photos and files between your phone and computer. No cables. No messengers. JPastePad — Simple sharing between any devices. Send text, photos, and files from your phone, tablet, or computer to any other device — in either direction. No accounts. No complicated setup. Just scan a QR code and share.ust scan. Scan. Send. Done. 100% Free. Simple. Fast.

records.name: Graphite Notebook
records.tagline: The AI notebook for making something of what you learn
records.description: Graphite is a notebook for people who learn something to make something of it: an article, a video, a talk. Write down what you're learning. Ask the Guide what you haven't worked out yet, teach it back, and get a draft arranged from your own sentences, or an article Graphite writes as a note labelled as its own. Edits are suggestions you accept or reject. Every note is a plain Markdown file. Free in your browser and on the Mac with your own AI key: Claude, GPT, Gemini and more.

records.name: Meadow
records.tagline: Hidden songs on your walk, chosen by people, not algorithms
records.description: Meadow lets you plant a song at a real place. Walk by and you can listen to what someone left there, collect it, and plant your own for the next person. No algorithm, just music that people chose for a place. Collect songs with your phone in your pocket using Live Activities, keep every find in your Garden, turn it into an Apple Music playlist, and see what your city is playing in the Feed. Free on TestFlight for iPhone.

records.name: Ponder
records.tagline: Goodreads for articles and longform journalism
records.description: ponder is Goodreads for articles, essays and longform journalism. Discover what's trending, save what you want to read next and rate what you finish. Build and share reading lists, follow other readers, and get a weekly digest of the highest-rated pieces. A browser extension saves any article in one click, and a year-end Readers Awards crowns the best writing of the year. Stop losing great articles in open tabs. Catalog your reading life.

records.name: DemocratiQ
records.tagline: Local civic polls where only verified residents can vote
records.description: DemocratiQ is a civic polling app for your area, city, state and country. Only verified residents of a place can vote on its polls, so results show what the people affected really think, not bots or outsiders. • Vote on local and national polls • See live results by area and demographics • Back public demands to the authority in charge • Final results are anchored to Bitcoin, so anyone can check they were never changed Free on web and Android.

records.name: Great Albion Furniture
records.tagline: Ready to Go or Made to Fit. Furniture for Hospitality.
records.description: Leading UK supplier of commercial furniture for cafes, restaurants, Shop quality chairs, tables, and catering furniture with reliable service.

records.name: WiAware
records.tagline: Know if your WiFi is good for a call before you join
records.description: Stop guessing whether your call will break. WiAware sits in your Mac's menu bar and tells you, in plain words, if your connection is good for a call, and if not, whether the problem is your WiFi, your router or the internet. It checks before each meeting in your calendar, watches closer during calls, and names the app eating your upload. A week of history stays on your Mac. No account, no analytics. Free for 14 days, then $14.99 once.

records.name: BlogFleet
records.tagline: A fleet of SEO & GEO-optimized blogs for your startup
records.description: BlogFleet gives your startup a fleet of blogs, each on its own domain, that write and publish themselves. Every run, it plans a new article or an update to an older one for each blog, then links back to your website with UTM tags so you can see the traffic it sends. Connect Google Search Console and compare your startup’s search results before and after your blogs. No writers, no CMS, no setup: just more ways for people to find you.

records.name: Maintano
records.tagline: One garage for cars and a boat. Hand over with one code.
records.description: Maintenance logbook for Android and iOS. Keep cars and a boat in one garage, log every service with receipt photos, get reminders by date or mileage, and, on Pro, hand the full history to a buyer with one code. Free for one vehicle, no account needed.

records.name: Editrolls
records.tagline: AI Video Editor for Tech Content Creators on Mac
records.description: Motion design for your tech explainers, without After Effects. Editrolls animates diagrams, captions and real product logos to your voice, right on your Mac.

records.name: FaaStr Flow
records.tagline: FaaStr Flow is an AI co-founder C-suite in Google Chat
records.description: FaaStr Flow is an AI co-founder C-suite for early-stage SaaS startups. It installs into Google Workspace, runs in Google Chat, and bundles FaaStr Ideas (validate the idea), FaaStr Products (design and ship the MVP) and FaaStr Capital (fund it, grow it, sell it) on one company knowledge graph.

records.name: PANDEIRO.APP
records.tagline: Learn the pandeiro in your browser
records.description: PANDEIRO.APP teaches Brazilian pandeiro in your browser. Every stroke has a color, and an on-screen pandeiro shows where and when to hit. Learn 148 rhythms, from samba and choro to frevo, with sheet music. Slow down with speed training, loop tricky bars, or practice layer by layer. Earn XP on missions and play Pandeiro Hero, a rhythm game that scores your timing. Works offline, in English and Portuguese. Try it free: pandeiro.app

records.name: Figura Labs
